files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Changed
- Statistics: each section can be collapsed or expanded by clicking its title, with "Collapse all" and "Expand all" buttons; collapsed sections are remembered in the browser.
- Statistics: 5-star sessions can be filtered by year (all years by default).
- Statistics: summary at the top of the page (number of sessions, years and spots); sessions per month show the change compared with the previous year (at the same date for the current year).
- Maps (spots, spot position, GPS track): full-screen button.
